hooks.hook_text: Your engineering team is racing to onboard 500 repositories in a week to support scaling.
hooks.rationale: As VP Finance, rapid scaling and massive repo onboarding mean a surge in transaction data that can overwhelm manual reconciliation processes, increasing risk and workload for the finance organization.
hooks.bridge: Our automation platform can instantly ingest and reconcile the flood of data from those repositories, eliminating manual effort and reducing errors.

hooks.hook_text: ShipBob just secured a $200 million funding round, pushing the company to unicorn status.
hooks.rationale: With a new $200M capital infusion, the finance team will need to manage larger cash flows, budgeting, and reporting while the business scales, making efficient reconciliation critical.
hooks.bridge: Our solution automates reconciliation‑heavy processes, giving your finance team the bandwidth to focus on strategic allocation of the new funds.
